name: Certified Nerd
ability: Each day, you may visit the storyteller to guess all in-play Townsfolk. If correct, learn all in-play characters, but if incorrect, you get false info.

name: Pflasterstein
ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a player. If good, they become a Pflasterstein. If evil, you die. One good player registers as evil to all Pflasterstein.

name: Doomscroller
flavor: Was, ich dommscrolle doch gar nicht!
ability: Once per game, during the day, you may visit the storyteller to learn X pieces of info, where X is the current day. Exactly one is true.

name: Know-it-All
ability: Once per game, you may change a word in a characters ability, excluding die. The Storyteller may choose you to prompt differently.

name: Werwolfspieler
ability: being boring

name: Meditator
ability: If you did not speak today, you can not die.

name: Sackmann
ability: Each night, choose 3 players. 2 are sober & healthy, 1 is drunk until dusk.

name: Outsider
ability: Once per game, at night, choose a player. A chosen outsider swaps characters with you and you both have no ability.

name: Truth Teller
ability: Once per game, at night *, choose up to 5 players and guess their characters. If any of your guesses are wrong, you die.

name: Yapper
ability: You start knowing a secret phrase. For each time you publicly say that phrase, tonight a player (not you) might be immortal.
You start knowing the allignment of your 6th or 7th clockwise neighbour. On night 6 or 7, good wins.

name: Sandra - Ich Lebe Noch
ability: On your first night, choose a player. When you learn that they died, you may proclaim your roles name. If you do, they regain their ability.

name: ichweissnichtwasmeinspielstilist
ability: Each night, learn a number equal to the sum of your alive good neighbours and dead evil players.

name: Black Cat
ability: Something bad might be happening to your right alive neighbour.

name: Two-Faced
ability: If the majority is mad you are good, you are evil. If the majority is mad you areevil, you are good

name: Ragebaiter
ability: If you are mad you are good or are not annoying, you might be executed, even if dead.

name: Pure Chaos
ability: Once per game, during the night, two players might switch characters.

name: Seal Boi
ability: Each night*, choose 3 players. They all must do their best seal impression. Something bad might happen to anyonebody who refuses or makes the worst impression. [ + Black Cat ]

name: Evil Saint
ability: If you die by execution, all Townsfolk are poisoned until dusk tomorrow. You register as good to all Pfastersteine [ + Pflasterstein ]

name: Shipper
ability: Each night, choose 2 players. If one dies tomorrow, the otherone dies tommorow night. One or both might learn this.

name: Crippling Gambling Addict
ability: Each night, choose any amount of players and guess their characters. If all are correct, all are poisoned until dusk.

name: Storyteller
ability: Each night, see the Grimoire. Each night*, you may change one thing. [ - 1 Outsider. - 1 Minion ]

name: Impath
ability: Each night*, choose up to X players, where X is the number of living good neighbours you have.

name: Spirit of Ivory
ability: There can't be more than 1 extra evil player.

name: Seife
ability: One player has the Seife: They can only speak like having soap in their mouth and are sober and healthy. The Seife passes each dawn.

name: Storyteller x Crippling Gambling Addict
ability: Only one jinxed character can be in play.

name: Werewolfspieler x Werwolfspieler
ability: [ + ? Werwolfspieler ] On the first night, if there are 3 or more Werwolfspieler in-play, all but one wake together with an evil player for 10 seconds.

name: Recommended Characters
ability: Empath//Oracle//Innkeeper//Steward//Devils Advocate
